author: Skquid
body:
After so may long years of not being in a team, I subbed for a team in a scrim (Xenarch), and I realized I should be doing it more often, so here it is.
I am above average in PvP.
I can bridge, but not the best.
I Rush a lot, can't really tell how great I am though.
I am pretty good with a bow, but I changed my FOV recently so I'm still getting used to it.
I've never really been on a team, so I don't know what position I can play well.
I have a TS and a Discord.

Hopefully I don't sound too indecisive of my own skills in Minecraft :L
